name: Mafia: The Omertà Collection
summary:
Mafia: The Omertà Collection includes:
• Mafia: The Old Country Definitive Edition, including the Man of Honor Expansion and Deluxe Edition content
• Mafia: Definitive Edition, including the PS5 and Xbox Series X|S versions with 60 FPS gameplay and technical improvements
• Mafia II: Definitive Edition, including all DLC
• Mafia III: Definitive Edition, including all DLC

Experience four distinct eras of organized crime with Mafia: The Omertà Collection. Step into the shoes of men bound to the Family across decades of mob history in these immersive, third-person action-adventures rich with cinematic storytelling.
